description: Minimal event-credit profiles are published. Expand these entries when artist material is supplied. No portrait has been invented or substituted.

profiles.name: William Rader
profiles.published_summary: William Rader is credited in the Modular Friends 001 programme at Plant Lovers Tbilisi.

profiles.name: Mo.Van
profiles.published_summary: Mo.Van appeared as a guest in the Modular Friends 006 programme alongside Progenol, Masa Trippin and AGAVA.

profiles.name: Wrong Fingers
profiles.published_summary: Wrong Fingers is a participating artist credited in Modular Friends 001, 002 and the Synthesia Lab programme for Modular Friends 011.

profiles.name: Nicolás Melmann
profiles.published_summary: Nicolás Melmann joined Modular Friends 012 as an international guest artist at Plant Lovers Tbilisi.

profiles.name: Jamanita
profiles.published_summary: David Janiashvili (Jamanita) is a visual artist creating real-time generative visuals with TouchDesigner. His work explores mathematical patterns and the interdependence between physical, mathematical, and material systems through immersive audiovisual environments.

profiles.name: Tusa
profiles.published_summary: Tusa contributes to the visual side of Modular Friends. The event archive includes video and artwork credits.

profiles.name: Yamada Tesla
profiles.published_summary: Yamada Tesla is credited in the visual programme for Modular Friends 012, alongside Nenealism and She Nocturne.
